evidence:
tests/test_native_conformance.py:143-147 docstring `V0-OUT-UNCERTAIN and V0-OUT-RECOVER` and :163-165 `self.node.exited(EXIT.UNCERTAIN)
        recovered = self.node.operator("recover", expect=EXIT.OK)
        self.assertIn(b"recovered transactions=", recovered.stdout)`
fix: After recover, start the owner, STAT/ARTICLE the unsure Message-ID and require it present and identical (the record is durable at log-fenced). Resubmit and require the idempotent duplicate.
reviewer: test_native_conformance.py:157-165: after the postpublish fault (log-fenced, record durable per io.lisp:4828-4831), the test checks only exit codes and the substring 'recovered transactions='. It never rereads or resubmits <outcome-unsure@example.invalid>, so V0-OUT-RECOVER's resolution of the article is not checked.
scenario: The postpublish fault fires after the log fence, so the record is durable. If recovery dropped it, or kept a torn record, `recover` still prints `recovered transactions=N` and exits 0. The test never rereads <outcome-unsure@example.invalid> and never resubmits it to confirm a duplicate (exit 0) with no second copy, so V0-OUT-RECOVER, which 'resolves the third' outcome, is not checked.
title: The conformance test of recovering the uncertain outcome checks only a substring, not what happened to the article
